SaksteinJain2017.notes: The sweep member that combines the bound with independent astrophysical data rather than using it alone.

EzquiagaZumalacarregui2017.title: Dark Energy after GW170817: dead ends and the road ahead
provides: broadest sweep coverage: Einstein-aether, Horava, Generalized Proca, TeVeS, MOND-like
EzquiagaZumalacarregui2017.notes: L1 leans on this paper's closing enumeration: every class it names has a Lagrangian predicting a varying c_g, which is exactly what the kinematic vestigial identification lacks.

BakerBellini2017.authors: Baker, T., Bellini, E., Ferreira, P. G., Lagos, M., Noller, J., Sawicki, I.
BakerBellini2017.title: Strong constraints on cosmological gravity from GW170817 and GRB 170817A
provides: constraints on scalar-tensor/vector-tensor functions under stated assumptions
conditional independent graviton-mass bound in bimetric gravity
BakerBellini2017.notes: Scalar/vector-tensor restrictions include the stated no-finely-tuned-cancellation premise; the bimetric mass bound has separate matter-coupling and mode-amplitude assumptions. Held arXiv:1710.06394v1 (17 October 2017), body pp.2-4.

CreminelliVernizzi2017.title: Dark Energy after GW170817 and GRB170817A
provides: no-tuning criterion: c_GW unaffected on nearby cosmological solutions
CreminelliVernizzi2017.notes: Nearby-background robustness criterion; the quartic/quintic beyond-Horndeski sector reduces to one B4 function while G2/G3 remain free. Held arXiv:1710.05877v3 (7 June 2018) is titled Dark Energy after GW170817; the distinct registered journal title is retained. Body pp.2-4, Eqs.(3)-(16).

SaksteinJain2017.title: Implications of the Neutron Star Merger GW170817 for Cosmological Scalar-Tensor Theories
provides: GW plus cluster/dwarf-star tests constrain beyond-Horndeski parameters; separate GW plus M87 constraints restrict the covariant quartic galileon
quartic-galileon cosmological-density restriction for stated order-unity matter couplings; disformal photon-coupling bound
SaksteinJain2017.notes: The cluster/dwarf-star parameter analysis and the GW-plus-M87 quartic-galileon inference are separate. The latter uses the representative order-unity matter couplings considered in the paper. Held arXiv:1710.05893v3 (18 December 2017), body pp.2-5, Eqs.(1)-(8) and Fig.2.

EzquiagaZumalacarregui2017.title: Dark Energy after GW170817: dead ends and the road ahead
provides: discussion of affected GW-speed-modifying couplings in Einstein-aether, some Horava sectors, Generalized Proca, TeVeS and MOND-like theories
EzquiagaZumalacarregui2017.notes: Explicit scalar-tensor actions and surviving sectors are analyzed; the closing enumeration discusses affected broader families without deriving a complete allowed-coefficient classification for every named family. The symmetric 5e-16 is this paper's adopted convention, not L1's conservative envelope. Held arXiv:1710.05901v2 (21 November 2017), body pp.2-5.
